general.after_polarized_isogeny: f_* phi^dagger phi f^*=[m*d] when phi^dagger phi=[m]
general.dlog_consequence: Q=[k]P in E[n] iff the corresponding nonzero transported images have the same k modulo n, provided gcd(m*d,n)=1

limitations: requires explicit executable pullback/pushforward (or diagonal/summation) maps
requires the polarized dual of any composed isogeny
does not solve arbitrary HECDLP instances outside the transported elliptic subgroup
does not improve the asymptotic hardness of the original elliptic DLP

P-224.complexity_interpretation: dimension reduction to the original ECDLP, not a speedup over the original ECDLP
P-224.identity: f_* o phi^dagger o phi o f^* = [m*d]
P-224.kernel_intersection: trivial on E[n] because the composed multiplier is invertible modulo n
P-224.scope: only the transported subgroup image; arbitrary classes in the full Jacobian or Prym component are not covered
